keywords: Verification process 2.Effectiveness/Acceptability 3.Data handling skills 4.Credibility 5.PBL for science and technology
educationalGoal: -To gain skills to verify hypotheses or solution concept with logical approaches. -To understand phenomena, objects and events quantitatively with high credibility. -To reliably find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objects, events. -To deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly. -To gain basic skills to credibly and smoothly conduct verification activities. -To have an image of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.
advice: The students will learn methodologies required to carry out processes to verify hypotheses; or, the students will gain methodologies to verify the effectiveness/acceptability of a solution concept, or a specific part of the concept. One is that the students will learn the basic “data-handling skills” needed for data collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis testing → visualization → reporting. One is that the students will learn “skills to proceed with verification processes” and “elementary skills of verification activities” from setting the hypothesis to its verification. In course, we will work on the design task of replacing the Asanogawa Bridge by utilizing the basic knowledge of structural mechanics, strength of materials, planning, and hydraulics acquired in the specialized subjects.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of structural mechanics, material mechanics, and hydraulics acquired in the project design introduction, I and II and in specialized subjects are required.

achievementLevels.ideal: To be able to proceed with verification processes for hypotheses and solution concepts. To be able to quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events and organize information. To be able to find and understand features, characteristics, and regularities of corresponding phenomena, objects, and events. To be able to communicate acquired information to a third person intelligibly. To be able to smoothly conduct verification activities. To be able to become aware of your specialties and imagine the technological fields and engineers.
achievementLevels.standard: To be able to proceed with verification processes for hypotheses and solution concepts with guidance. To be able to quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events and organize the information with guidance from the instructor. To be able to find and understand characteristics and regularities of phenomena, objects, etc., with guidance. To be able to share acquired information to third person. To be able to smoothly conduct verification activities with guidance from the instructor. To be able to recognize your specialties and imagine the technological fields and engineers with guidance.
